name: Seal Hunter
summary:
Seal Hunter is a freeware 2D shoot ’em up game featuring not only tons of blood and gore, but also the possibility for four players to ensure the future of Norway’s fishing industry together. United we stand, right?

With a large array of weapons at your disposal, you must prevent harmful sea creatures from reaching the ocean in order to ensure a decent catch of fish the next morning. The enemies range everything from seals to fierce polar bears – but they must be downed, regardless.

This is an approved remake of the original The Seal Hunter (2005).
